QuestionStmt.S: If X is a binomial variable with range {0, 1, 2, 3, 4} and $$P(X = 3) = 3P(X = 4)$$ then the parameter 'p' of the binomial distribution is

Solution.S:
Here, $n = 4$

$$P(X = 3) = 3P(X = 4)$$

$$\therefore 4C_3 p^3 q = 3 \cdot 4C_4 p^4 q^0$$

$$\therefore 4p^3 q = 3p^4$$

$$\therefore 4(1 - p) = 3p \quad [\because p + q = 1]$$

$$\therefore 4 - 4p = 3p$$

$$\therefore 4 = 7p$$

$$\therefore p = \frac{4}{7}$$
